title: Bolus delivery error while being delivered. Not recorded in NS.
symptom: During the last week I have experienced 3 times the following: 1. I give bolus using the wizard. 2. Bolus delivery error appears on AAPS 3. Bolus is being delivered when I manually check the pump. 4. Bolus not recorded in NS, unless I click 'Refresh' button in Medtronic Menu and get the pump's recent history. 5. Carbs also not recorded in NS. I have to manually add them in AAPS.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One user speculates that the pump was busy with something else, perhaps SMB, but no confirmation.
fix: No fix is stated. The issue remains unresolved; one user switched pumps.
evidence_quote: Don't know why it happens, think the pump was busy with something other, perhaps SMB ?
